author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: "तान्" "अवस्थितान्" "सर्वान्बन्धून्" समीक्ष्यैवेत्येवकारेणान्वयः । विषीदन्विशादं कुर्वन् ।  'विषादो नाम मोहनिमित्तकाच्छोकाद्यन्मनोदौर्बल्यं यस्मिन्सति सर्वव्यापारोपरमो भवति स', इति ज्ञेयम्
translation: There standing up in both the armies, Partha saw fathers (uncles) and grandfathers, teachers and mother's brothers, brothers (cousins), sons and grandsons, comrades, fathers-in-law, and benefactors; seeing all these kinsmen standing arrayed, that Kunti's son was deeply moved to pity and in sadness spoke this (as follows). (26,27)
